Wendell Martin, James L. Miller, Wayne C. Ponader, Floyd W. Burns, C. B. Dutton, Thomas M. Scanlon, Ben J. Weaver, Howard S. Young, Jr., and Norman P. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
